question: Where is the head office of the Sports Authority of India located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sports Authority of India (SAI) is the apex national sports body of India for the development of sport in India.
 
 
• It was **established in 1984**.
 
• Its parent agency is the **Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs, and Sports**.
 
• SAI has **2 Sports Academic institutions**, **11 SAI Regional Centres**, **14 Centre of Excellence (COE/COX)**, **56 Sports Training Centres,** and **20 Special Area Games (SAG)**.
